messages:
hannah: quick note - we should finalize the webinar abstract variants for the registration page. Thinking 2 versions: technical (benchmarks + ops) and business (cost + outcomes).

omar: agreed. i'll draft the biz one. viv, can you take the technical?

viv: sure. technical draft below: 
'Technical abstract: Join Redwood Inference engineers for a deep dive into production LLM serving. We'll share benchmark methodology, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a live failover demo showing routing and KV caching in practice.'

mike: biz draft: 
'Business abstract: Learn how teams cut inference costs and improve reliability while shipping LLM features. We'll highlight real customer scenarios, cost-per-inference benchmarks, and next steps to try Redwood.'

hannah: both look good. small edits: add "who should attend" and a 1-line outcome. e.g., for technical: "Who should attend: infra/platform engineers, ML infra. Outcome: concrete runbook for safe rollouts."

omar: I'll integrate and push to CMS after copy review. split-test abstracts across channels? perhaps LinkedIn ads use biz, developer communities use technical.

calendar-bot: Registration open. Webinar: "May 12 - Serving LLMs at Scale" 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC.

hannah: ok final step: confirm draft CTAs. Options: 'Reserve your seat' vs 'Request a performance audit'. leaning to 'Reserve your seat' on registration page and use audit CTA in the enterprise follow-up.

omar: agreed. nice and simple. I'll update the page and loop design in PR.

hannah: action items: omar - push biz abstract to CMS (due 2026-04-21), viv - finalize technical abstract (due 2026-04-21), mike - social copy variations (due 2026-04-22).
